description: Fail closed: a missing or failing git guard blocks the Bash call (exit 2). SessionStart and the implement-plan skill's Stop hook warn instead (exit 1), since exit 2 on Stop would trap the session.

hooks.command: g="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/git-guard.sh"; [ -x "$g" ] || { echo "git-guard: $g is missing or not executable; Bash is blocked until it is back" >&2; exit 2; }; "$g" || exit 2
b="$HOME/.claude/agent-bus.sh"; [ -x "$b" ] || { echo "agent-bus: $b is missing; peers are not listed" >&2; exit 1; }; exec "$b" hook session-start
